digest.component_or_area: compact_txn / fsck snapshot compaction and orphan repair
propositions: Natural fold enumeration retires and cites orphan files in source_event_uuids despite their effects being buried by replay positional skip, converting repairable damage into undetectable loss.
The fold must exclude un-cited pre-snapshot events from both retirement and source_event_uuids citation, deferring absorption to the existing fsck repair door.
Pre-snapshot foldable candidates must not fold without their governing snapshot present to avoid silently burying orphans under a younger pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT.
The fsck --repair-snapshots door must enforce the same _AUTO_RECOVER/_HUMAN_TRIAGE routing applied by --repair instead of rebuilding unconditionally on any orphan type.
Orphan exclusion predicate must be extracted and shared between compact_txn and fsck to prevent drift and ensure both doors agree on orphan classification.
